source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

source_refs: 1f_view.png crop [380,500,500,800]: 240 label with tick marks; start tick at x=426 sits on the outer (exterior, offset 0) face and end tick at x=446 sits on the inner (offset 0.24) face of wall-F1-west-facade

joins.reason: gap, mixed basis or unconfirmed join; no automatic closure

wall_dimension_report.scope: caller-supplied endpoint semantics; no image verdict, calibration fitting or geometry mutation

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East (unchanged from seed).
Wall thickness ~0.24m generally per plan hatch/jamb annotations; representative planes at wall centerlines/faces as previously established; not globally revised this pass.

F1 north-row partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m sit at dimension-chain jog points where 240mm of the 15000mm header total is omitted from printed labels; per-wall split unknown, representative planes kept at seed values.

dim-west-240's declared host was corrected this pass from space/F1_R1S/wall/3 to space/F1_R1N/wall/3: an overlay calibration (1f_view.png, anchors from the 15000mm/8000mm overall chains) showed the saved evidence pixels (426,530)-(446,530) project to world y=5.94m, inside the F1_R1N wall span [5,8] and ~2.94m outside the previously declared F1_R1S span [0,3]. The 240mm value/pixels are unchanged; only host attribution was fixed. The reading is treated as directly observed only for the F1_R1N segment and transferred by continuity assumption (same straight, uninterrupted west facade) to F1_R1S and the corridor, which have no separate local label of their own.

dim-north-240's host (wall-F1-north-facade, space/F1_R1N/wall/2) was checked via the same overlay: its evidence pixels project inside the declared wall's tangential range with small normal displacement consistent with the declared 0/-0.24 offsets, so no correction was needed there.

unresolved: F1 partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m: individual thickness/offset unresolved; only the aggregate 240mm gap across both jogs is evidenced.
F1 corridor partition walls (y=3/y=5) and any west-chain vs east-chain closure conflict noted in prior passes were not re-examined this pass (out of the bounded local-evidence-correction scope).
2f_view.png overlay calibration, F1 north-row window span residuals, F1 east window sill/head height residual, and F2 ConfA/ConfB door split remain unresolved as carried over from prior passes.
Door swing direction/leaf count and room role labels remain unresolved.

Overlay calibration itself carries a flagged cross-axis scale disagreement (~5.3%) and residuals up to ~0.32m on the overall 8000/15000mm anchors; the west-facade host correction (~2.94m mismatch) is far larger than this calibration slack, so it is considered robust, but the calibration is not independently verified and finer sub-metre placements on this frame should be treated with caution.

Only the two existing local wall-thickness dimension records (dim-north-240, dim-west-240) and their declared wall hosts were checked this pass, per scope; other openings, partitions and rooms were not re-examined and remain from the seed/prior passes.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

calibration_warnings.guidance: x=94.8666667 px/m and y=90 px/m disagree by 5.265056%, over the 0.300000% limit — at least one endpoint pair or transcribed dimension is likely wrong. Do not silently trust the blended px_per_m below: re-crop and re-measure both axes' anchors at their dimension-chain extension-line intersections, then recalibrate. If you must proceed now, prefer the single-axis scale (axis_px_per_m) for geometry measured along that axis over the blended value, and record this disagreement instead of treating the reading as clean.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
